entry.title: Add extensionTypes.IconVariant and pageAction.setIcon variants, and the Firefox bug for the icon variants APIs.
entry.content:
Summary

Adds extensionTypes.IconVariant and the variants parameter of pageAction.setIcon(), records the any and colorSchemes properties, and adds the Firefox and Chrome bugs for the icon variants APIs.

  • extensionTypes.IconVariant: Safari 18.2. It is a dictionary type, so like ImageDetails it describes the structure the APIs accept, and no browser exposes it on the extensionTypes object.
  • extensionTypes.IconVariant.any and icon_variants.any: Safari 18.2, partial, because Safari prefers any over every explicit size in a group instead of using it only when no other size is large enough: https://webkit.org/b/330501.
  • extensionTypes.IconVariant.colorSchemes: Safari 26.2, with color_schemes as the alternative name from Safari 18.2.
  • icon_variants.color_schemes in the manifest: Safari 18.2.
  • pageAction.setIcon() variants: Safari 18.2. Safari maps pageAction onto the same implementation as action.
  • https://bugzil.la/1955199 is the Firefox impl_url for the type and for the variants and iconVariants parameters of action.setIcon(), browserAction.setIcon(), pageAction.setIcon(), menus.create() and menus.update().
  • https://crbug.com/41419485 is the Chrome impl_url for the type and for action.setIcon().

The mdn_url for the new type is left out until the MDN page exists.

Test results and supporting details

npm run lint -- webextensions passes.

  • mdn/content#46364
  • w3c/webextensions#949

Related issues

Follows #31029 and #31065.

entry.title: fix(html): add Safari notes for datalist with styled range inputs
entry.content:
Closes #30932

Safari supports datalist with <input type="range"> since 12.1, but tick marks and option labels disappear when:

  • appearance: none is applied to the range input
  • the datalist is given a visible display value

entry.title: Updates for Safari TP 255
entry.content:
The https://collector.openwebdocs.org/ project (v10.21.1) found new features shipping in Safari Technical Preview 255 on macOS 27 which was released last week. Currently, the collector covers about 90% of BCD, so the following list might not be exhaustive.

Release notes: https://webkit.org/blog/18482/release-notes-for-safari-technology-preview-255/

New (bold) and updated keys:

  • api.SVGTextPathElement.side
  • css.properties.border-block-end-radius
  • css.properties.border-block-start-radius
  • css.properties.border-bottom-radius
  • css.properties.border-inline-end-radius
  • css.properties.border-inline-start-radius
  • css.properties.border-left-radius
  • css.properties.border-right-radius
  • css.properties.border-top-radius
  • css.properties.continue.collapse
  • css.properties.interpolate-size
  • css.properties.interpolate-size.allow-keywords
  • css.properties.interpolate-size.numeric-only

Notes:

  • The STP 255 release notes don't mention border-*-radius side shorthands and interpolate-size, but they were mentioned for STP 254: https://webkit.org/blog/18420/release-notes-for-safari-technology-preview-254/. For BCD, the result is the same, it gets marked as "preview" now.
